conversational_intelligence.dialogue_policy: Intents: clarification, repeat, uncertainty, skip, answer; localized across en-IN, te-IN, hi-IN

bounded_personalization.resume_parser: Bounded to 50,000 characters; regex competency and project extraction; no external LLM
